name: skills
description: Tooling for the skills repo: Biome, rumdl, ShellCheck and shfmt

scripts.check: biome check . && rumdl check . && git ls-files -z '*.sh' harness-kit/bin/agent-env | grep -zv /evals/files/ | xargs -0 shellcheck && git ls-files -z '*.sh' harness-kit/bin/agent-env | grep -zv /evals/files/ | xargs -0 shfmt -d
scripts.fix: biome check --write . && git ls-files -z '*.sh' harness-kit/bin/agent-env | grep -zv /evals/files/ | xargs -0 shfmt -w
scripts.format: biome format --write . && git ls-files -z '*.sh' harness-kit/bin/agent-env | grep -zv /evals/files/ | xargs -0 shfmt -w
scripts.lint: biome lint . && rumdl check . && git ls-files -z '*.sh' harness-kit/bin/agent-env | grep -zv /evals/files/ | xargs -0 shellcheck
